title: Grant or revoke permissions in a scheme
content:
Once you’ve created a permission scheme, use it to define what actions users can perform in your spaces. What permissions I grant in a space?
The processes on this page require the Administer Jira permission.
To grant permissions using a scheme:
- Select Settings (), then Work items.
- Under the Work item attributes section, select Permission Schemes. You may need to scroll down since it’s at the bottom of the list.
- Select either the name of the scheme you want to update or Permissions in the actions column. This opens the detailed view of the permissions in this scheme.
- Find the permission you want to edit and select Update.
- Next, select who you’d like to grant this permission to. Permissions in a scheme can be given to: 
  - Space roles - this refers to any custom space roles that you’ve set up – More about managing space roles
  - Application access - any user with access to an app
  - Group - these groups are managed by your Organization admin. Reach out to them to update group membership or to remove users from a group
  - Public - More about publicly available spaces
  - Any logged in user
  - Current assignee - this grants access to anyone listed in a work item’s Assignee field
  - Reporter - this grants access to anyone listed in a work item’s Reporter field
  - Group custom field value - this grants access to anyone listed in a Group picker (single or multi-select) type field on a work item. You’ll be asked which field you want to reference.
  - Space lead - this grants access to anyone listed as the Space owner on a space’s Details page. This is not the same as the Administer spaces permission.
  - Single user - any user invited by your admin
  - User custom field value - this grants access to anyone listed in a User picker (single or multi-select) type field on a work item. You’ll be asked which field you want to reference.
- When you're done, select Update.
Was this helpful?
